basic_info.description: This full-floor 2BR/1BA oasis blends contemporary updates and Edwardian charm.  Wainscoting detail and hardwood flooring adorn the condo, the front bedroom and living room boast light-filled bay windows. The spacious living room has an original decorative fireplace with an early 1900s tiled hearth. The flexible layout offers multiple options for configuration; off the living room is a second bedroom with original pocket doors great for use as a double parlor.  The back of the home comprises the open kitchen, family room, and dining area. The kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, concrete countertops, and breakfast bar. The full BR has a restored clawfoot tub and concrete countertop. The laundry room offers a w/d and additional storage.
